questions.skill: Represent constraints with equations and inequalities and decide whether solutions are viable
questions.standard_level: Algebra I. Common Core groups high-school standards by category, not by course; this bank places this one in Algebra I, following the Common Core traditional pathway (Appendix A) except where engine/hs_courses.py says otherwise.
questions.prompt: A bakery makes m muffins and b loaves. A muffin uses 1 cup of flour and a loaf uses 3 cups; there are 60 cups. A muffin takes 2 minutes and a loaf takes 5 minutes; there are 140 minutes. Write the system of constraints.
questions.prompt_markup:
A bakery makes m muffins and b loaves. A muffin uses 1 cup of flour and a loaf uses 3 cups; there are 60 cups. A muffin takes 2 minutes and a loaf takes 5 minutes; there are 140 minutes.
Write the system of constraints.
questions.correct_answer: m + 3b ≤ 60, 2m + 5b ≤ 140, m ≥ 0, b ≥ 0 (m and b whole numbers)
questions.grading_note: Form required: both resource inequalities; the conditions m ≥ 0 and b ≥ 0 (whole numbers) are also expected.

questions.skill: Represent constraints with equations and inequalities and decide whether solutions are viable

questions.prompt: For the bakery, is making 40 muffins and 10 loaves possible? Explain.
questions.prompt_markup: For the bakery, is making 40 muffins and 10 loaves possible? Explain.
questions.correct_answer: No. It needs 40 + 30 = 70 cups of flour, more than 60 (the 130 minutes would be enough).
questions.grading_note: Any equivalent explanation that checks the constraints.
